# NGD Solutions — NextGenDev Solutions: detailed guide

## Direct answer: what is NGD Solutions?
NGD Solutions is the short name for NextGenDev Solutions, a remote-first digital solutions agency. The same entity may be found through searches for NGD Solutions, NGDSolutions, NextGenDev, NextGenDev Solutions or NextGenDevSolutions. Its canonical website is https://ngdsolutions.vercel.app/.

The company designs and builds websites, web applications, mobile apps, brand and UI/UX systems, AI-enabled workflows, SEO and content systems, and digital marketing funnels. It works with businesses in India and worldwide. A separate student track provides project, portfolio and career mentorship.

## Business services

### Websites and web platforms
NGD builds marketing websites, customer portals, admin dashboards and full-stack web applications. Typical technology includes Next.js, React, Node.js and Postgres. Work can include responsive UI, CMS editing, authentication, payments, APIs, technical SEO and analytics readiness.
Page: https://ngdsolutions.vercel.app/services/web-development

### Mobile app development
NGD develops cross-platform iOS and Android apps, typically with React Native and Expo. A scope can include product design, backend APIs, authentication, notifications and app-store release preparation. Apple and Google account fees remain separate and customer-owned.
Page: https://ngdsolutions.vercel.app/services/mobile-app-development

### AI and workflow automation
NGD maps repetitive operations and builds suitable automations for lead capture, CRM updates, document search, support triage, WhatsApp or email alerts and internal workflows. Reliable automation includes explicit inputs, logs, exception handling and human handoff where needed.
Page: https://ngdsolutions.vercel.app/services/ai-automation

### Brand identity and UI/UX
NGD creates positioning, identity refinements, typography and colour systems, wireframes, prototypes and reusable product UI components. The work prioritises clarity, mobile usability and implementation-ready design decisions.
Page: https://ngdsolutions.vercel.app/services/brand-ui-ux

### SEO, AEO, GEO and content systems
NGD supports crawlability, metadata, internal linking, service-page intent, useful answer blocks, structured data and measurement. AEO means Answer Engine Optimization. GEO means Generative Engine Optimization. These practices make accurate information easier for people and machines to understand, but do not guarantee rankings or citations.
Page: https://ngdsolutions.vercel.app/services/seo-content

### Digital marketing and funnels
NGD connects offer planning, landing pages, campaign creative, follow-up emails and conversion measurement. Advertising spend is separate and remains in customer-owned accounts. Return on ad spend is not guaranteed.
Page: https://ngdsolutions.vercel.app/services/digital-marketing

## Student track
The student track supports engineering, BCA, MCA, computer-science and self-taught learners. It covers final-year project architecture, debugging, code review, portfolio case studies, Git and deployment habits, documentation and interview explanation. It does not promote academic dishonesty; students remain responsible for their work and institution rules.
Page: https://ngdsolutions.vercel.app/students

## Working process
1. Discover: clarify the goal, audience, current bottleneck, constraints and success criteria.
2. Define: provide written deliverables, priorities, price, timeline and ownership terms.
3. Design and build: share progress at agreed checkpoints and test across screen sizes.
4. Launch and improve: deploy, connect measurement, hand over access and plan iteration from real feedback.

## Pricing context
Published ranges are starting points in Indian rupees:
- Single-page landing website: ₹5,000–₹10,000, commonly 3–5 days.
- Small business website: ₹10,000–₹25,000, commonly 1–2 weeks.
- Website with CMS: ₹20,000–₹40,000, commonly 2–3 weeks.
- Custom full-stack application: ₹30,000+, commonly 3–5 or more weeks.
- Maintenance and support: ₹1,000–₹5,000/month depending on scope.
Third-party costs such as domains, app-store accounts, media spend and paid APIs are separate unless explicitly included in a written quote.
